aod-9604: Rodent lipolysis does not establish human benefit.
bpc-157: Single-lineage rodent findings require independent human trials.
cerebrolysin: No healthy-adult cognition RCT; disease results cannot establish enhancement.
dihexa: Human enhancement and long-term oncologic safety unestablished.
dsip: Original rabbit findings did not establish a human sleep treatment.
epithalon: Single-group findings have methodological and replication limitations.
follistatin-344: Sustained local expression cannot establish transient protein-injection benefit in healthy adults.
foxo4-dri: No human PK/efficacy/safety; research-peptide self-administration unsupported.
ghrp-2: No controlled enhancement outcomes; less selective than ipamorelin; WADA-prohibited.
ghrp-6: Human GH response requires endogenous GHRH.
No performance/body-composition/longevity trials; hunger and lower endocrine selectivity limit extrapolation.
hexarelin: GH response wanes with chronic dosing.
Neither GH biomarkers nor preclinical CD36 effects establish functional benefit.
humanin: No human dosing benefit; most therapeutic animal work uses HNG, not native humanin.
igf-1-lr3: No controlled healthy-adult outcomes; mecasermin approval does not establish LR3 efficacy or safety.
ipamorelin: No controlled body-composition/performance/recovery/longevity outcomes; biomarker extrapolation only.
kisspeptin: Pharmaceutical KP54 infusion results do not validate research-product SC self-administration or generic healthy-adult enhancement.
kpv: Preclinical anti-inflammatory activity; topical utility plausible.
Systemic efficacy/safety and healthy-adult physique/performance/healthspan benefit unestablished.
liraglutide: Indication-specific T2D (≥10y), T2D+CVD MACE reduction, and weight management (eligible pediatric ≥12y, >60kg). Generic availability improves access; newer incretins generally produce greater weight loss.
Daily injections; results apply to studied BMI/disease populations, not general enhancement.
ll-37: Psoriasis/rosacea biology shows increased LL-37 can harm; systemic supplementation is not inherently beneficial.
mazdutide: China-specific obesity/T2D indications in reviewed record.
No healthy-weight/non-diabetic enhancement trial evidence; jurisdiction-specific approval matters.
melanotan-ii: Anecdotal tanning/appetite/sexual effects; no approved indication.
Melanoma/lesion, priapism, hypertension and rhabdomyolysis reports; uncertain supply. Vyleesi has a distinct regulated HSDD indication.
mots-c: Endogenous correlations and rodent effects do not establish exogenous dosing benefit; receptor/uptake unresolved.
oxytocin: Small intranasal social-processing signals; psychiatric RCTs mixed.
No established chronic nootropic/mood/relationship benefit; effects depend on social context.
pinealon: No rigorous independent human cognition/longevity/anti-aging trial evidence.
pramlintide: Labeled insulin adjunct, not established non-diabetic weight-loss therapy; severe insulin-associated hypoglycemia risk.
pt-141: Approved for acquired generalized HSDD in eligible premenopausal women.
Male/postmenopausal/recreational use not established by label; >8doses/month increases exposure-related concerns.
retatrutide: Strong early trial weight-loss signals (~28.7% at12mg/68wk).
Investigational; not healthy-adult enhancement evidence. Durability/rebound/long-term safety uncertain; non-trial supply unapproved.
selank: No independent pivotal replication; mechanism and non-Russian chronic safety uncertain.
semaglutide: Product-specific diabetes, obesity, cardiovascular and noncirrhotic MASH F2–F3 indications.
Trial results do not establish cosmetic/performance benefit or long-term safety outside eligible populations.
semax: Russian stroke/cognition experience and preclinical neurotrophin signals.
Independent pivotal healthy-adult nootropic evidence absent.
sermorelin: Historical pediatric GH-deficiency benefit; adult enhancement evidence limited.
Preserved feedback and pediatric/diagnostic results do not establish healthy-adult anti-aging/body-composition/sleep benefit.
snap-8: Modest, mostly manufacturer-sponsored topical wrinkle findings.
Cosmetic ingredient; comparative Botox-like efficacy unestablished.
ss-31: Positive signals chiefly in mitochondrial disease.
Barth/PMM or aged-animal findings do not establish healthy-adult performance/longevity benefit; baseline dysfunction may limit response.
tb-500: Local eye/skin trial experience does not establish systemic human efficacy.
tb4-frag: No approved indication or controlled systemic healthy-adult recovery/performance evidence; marketing exceeds human data.
teduglutide: No healthy-adult enhancement rationale; neoplasia and biliary/pancreatic monitoring remain essential.
tesamorelin: Non-HIV/healthy/pediatric enhancement efficacy and long-term CV/neoplastic safety unestablished.
thymosin-alpha-1: No controlled healthy-adult immune-boosting/anti-aging benefit; COVID cohorts are observational.
thymulin: Aged/zinc-deficient animal findings do not establish benefit in healthy zinc-sufficient adults.
tirzepatide: Product-specific T2D, weight-management and obesity-associated moderate/severe OSA indications.
Cosmetic use outside studied BMI/disease criteria lacks equivalent efficacy/safety evidence.
vip: No established healthy-adult enhancement; early COVID signals failed Phase 3 confirmation.
hcg: Testosterone stimulation and ovulation triggering; post-cycle use off-label.
Post-cycle efficacy and comparative male-hypogonadism data limited; weight-loss trials negative/unreproduced, no approval.
mk-677: Older-adult GH/IGF-1↑ (~60–84% over6–12mo); fat-free mass +~1.6kg/12mo; slow-wave-sleep signals.
No proven strength/cognition benefit or Phase 3 indication; >2yr healthy-population safety, younger-user cardiac risk and long-term glycemia unresolved.
5-amino-1mq: Mouse adiposity↓ without lower food intake; muscle/grip and adipocyte NAD⁺/MNA signals.
No published human PK/efficacy/safety; formal toxicology/carcinogenicity and long-term human NAD⁺ effects unknown.
